reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Add digest pinning to image automation testing by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5383", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The line describes adding digest pinning to image automation testing only, and states no effect on running clusters, existing resources or configuration; there is nothing an operator must do.

proposed.statement: The flux 2.7.0 release notes state that digest pinning was added to image automation testing (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5383); the single changelog line names no user-facing surface and describes no effect on existing environments.
